status.description: Outcome of the mission. specs: QUESTIONS or SPEC_FINALE. Other agents: DONE. Any agent: BLOCKED when the mission cannot be completed.

comment.description: Markdown posted in the issue for the PM, in French, plain language. specs QUESTIONS: the full question block. specs SPEC_FINALE: two lines introducing the final spec. plan DONE: the 5-line summary. BLOCKED: the precise cause and what the PM can do.

summary.description: One technical line for the run log, in English.
